Monday: the founder's four decisions and the day's two teams - Drew into the scene (team Drew), the inlaid back bar (design round)
Drew placed in the left chair, seed 41 - first cast-place round
entries.verdict: USABLE as round 1 and the method is proved: Drew is in the approved chair at the right scale in the right room. Not final - he sits a little high and left of the seat centre, the chair's studded roll does not cross his lower back (he reads as floating just in front of the chair), and the sticker carries a patch of the model's own marble under his hands whose white does not quite match the plate's. Cleanliness 0.796 outside the sticker: that number is the model re-inking the room, not a prompt fault, and the sticker route is what makes it harmless.

entries.title: the inlaid back bar, design round: the flush inlay (two bottle rows in a recess cut into the wall, its own boarded lining) chosen over a cabinet that read as a box; two fixes before any render
entries.verdict: I1 chosen; render after the fixes

the inlaid back bar rendered and approved into the plate: two rows of bottles in a recess cut into the wall, the drinks ledge beneath, the wall untouched (seed 7)
entries.verdict: in the plate - for the founder's approval

entries.title: FOUNDER APPROVED the inlaid back bar - next: clean the wood grain round the shelf and rebuild the bottles (real shapes and sizes, at least half full, real labels)
entries.verdict: founder: approved the shelves; bottles and lining in work

entries.title: Drew into the room - ROUTE A flat field, seed 41, laid on the approved plate
entries.verdict: REJECT the picture, KEEP the route. Front view, wrong scale, a dog that came out of Picture 3 - but the join is the softest of the four and the approved room survives everywhere outside the sticker.

entries.title: Drew into the room - ROUTE A flat field, seed 7, laid on the approved plate
entries.verdict: REJECT the picture. Two birds and a dog, all front on. Same conclusion as seed 41: the route is sound, the staging reference is what is poisoning it.

entries.title: Drew into the room - ROUTE B whole crop, seed 41, laid on the approved plate
entries.verdict: REJECT, and reject the route. The join is a visible white block: 65 grey levels at the seam against route A's 40.

entries.title: Drew into the room - ROUTE B whole crop, seed 7, laid on the approved plate
entries.verdict: REJECT. Worst join of the four at 71.5 levels and the furthest from the pinned staging.
